Relevant memories from kb (recall — these persist across sessions):
- demo-repo build cache setup  [kb]
    ↳ installed 2026-08-01; measured a modest speedup of roughly 15% (not the hoped-for 60%) because the build host is disk-bound not compute-bound; the parallel-jobs convention only helps once the scheduler is tuned, and the stale-lock gotcha bites when a build is killed mid-link rather than left to finish naturally.
<!--kb-recall/1 kb=kb id=a1b2c3d4e5f6 pos=1-->
- ⚠ disputed: Wrong port for the staging service  [main] [⚠ 1 drift-flagged citation(s)]
    ↳ the staging service binds 127.0.0.1:9000 in the demo env and a spare port everywhere else; never curl 9000 from a test, and never bind it either — the demo container owns it and a bind fails closed, not shared.
<!--kb-recall/1 kb=main id=0f0f0f0f0f0f pos=2-->
- demo-repo fixture builds are IO-bound, not CPU-bound  [kb]
    ↳ the demo-repo build tree and its fixture corpus share one disk, so a parallel build starves the test run; tuned by pruning a background index job, switching the disk scheduler and lowering swap use.
